title: Kia Owners (US) - Kia Charge Pass: NACS adapter offer
notes: Free adapter for new 2024 or 2025 EV9 and new 2024 EV6 bought or leased on or after Sept 4, 2024, one per VIN, while supplies last. CCS-port Kia vehicles need a Kia-approved NACS-to-CCS adapter; EVs outside the offer may buy one (contact a Kia dealer).
